CHANGELOG updated in SHANKPIT: feat(buggy): programmable buggy (#468/#464d) — handling (transmission curve, top speeds, steering, grip) is now the PARENA mod stdlib/shankpit/buggy_rules.prn, generated into buggy_rules.c, installed into physics.h's PhysBuggyRules hook by buggy_rules_host.h in server + lobby (tests that only include physics.h keep the built-ins). Defaults match the old constants (759.6 vs 759.8 units/240 ticks); a 2x-top-speed mod measurably changes the buggy. make regen-buggy-rules. README gains a 'Buggy: walls, placement, PARENA handling, lighting' section. (sess-20260923-1030-4a526255)

⚓ ☃
